title: Quick Jamaican Jerk Chicken
description: A flavorful and spicy jerk chicken dish, perfect for a quick and delicious meal. Marinated in authentic Jamaican spices and grilled to perfection.
instructions: 1. In a blender or food processor, combine jerk seasoning, garlic, brown sugar, allspice, thyme, and lime juice.
2. Blend until smooth, then transfer to a large bowl.
3. Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the jerk marinade.
4. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
6. Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
7. Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
8. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
9. Grill the chicken in a skillet on the stovetop if you don't have an outdoor grill.
10. Cook the chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
